problems.problem: Let $f:[a,b]\to\mathbb R$ be continuously differentiable, with $f(a)=f(b)=0$. Prove that $\displaystyle\max_{x\in[a,b]}|f'(x)|\ge\frac{1}{(b-a)^2}\int_a^b|f(x)|\,dx$.
Find all functions $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ satisfying $xf(y)+yf(x)=(x+y)f(x)f(y)$ for all real $x,y$.
Let $\mathbb Z_k$ be the additive group of residue classes modulo $k$. Decide whether $\mathbb Z_6$ is isomorphic to $\mathbb Z_2\times\mathbb Z_3$.

Prove that every nonzero rational number $p/q$ can be written $\displaystyle\frac pq=b_1+\frac{b_2}{2!}+\cdots+\frac{b_n}{n!}$, where $n$ is a sufficiently large positive integer and $b_k\in\mathbb Z$ for $k>1$, $0\le b_k<k$, and $b_n\ne0$.
